title: AION 2 Global Changes: Launch Differences from KR/TW
description: Compare AION 2 Global launch progression and classes with KR/TW Chapter 1. Check level caps, Brawler availability, dungeon requirements and Founder changes.
summary: Global starts with level-45 progression and eight classes. Use the correct regional content and upgrade rules before following a KR/TW route.
quickAnswer: Global launch has a character-level cap of 45 and eight classes. KR/TW Chapter 1 raised the cap to 50 and added Brawler and later dungeons. Match your guide to Global before investing in a build. Founder cosmetic sharing announced October 3 is awaiting implementation.
